op.title: 1Password reference
op.description: An op:// secret reference, resolved through the 1Password SDK at run time

OpReference.title: 1Password reference
OpReference.description: Resolved through the 1Password SDK using OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN from the environment

env.title: Environment variable
env.description: The name of an environment variable holding the value

EnvReference.title: Environment variable reference
EnvReference.description: For CI, where the platform's secret store injects the value

CredentialSource.title: GitHub token
CredentialSource.description: Reference to a fine-grained personal access token. Never the token itself — use { op = "op://..." } or { env = "VAR" }.

anyOf.title: 1Password references
anyOf.description: Named values resolved via the 1Password SDK. Values are op:// reference strings.

anyOf.title: Environment variable references
anyOf.description: Named values read from the environment. Values are variable names, not values.

anyOf.title: File references
anyOf.description: Named values read from files. Values are paths relative to the credentials directory.

anyOf.title: Inline values
anyOf.description: Named inline values. Strings are used as-is, objects are JSON-stringified.

ResolveSection.title: Resolve section
ResolveSection.description: Named values resolved from 1Password, the environment, or files, for use by resolved groups

username.title: GitHub username
username.description: The personal account this profile acts as. Mutually exclusive with org.

org.title: GitHub organization
org.description: The organization this profile acts within. Mutually exclusive with username.

CredentialProfile.title: Credential profile
CredentialProfile.description: Exactly one of username or org, a GitHub token reference, and any named values to resolve

profiles.title: Credential profiles
profiles.description: Named credential profiles. Every group names one explicitly in its `credentials` field.

Credentials.title: reposets Credentials
Credentials.description: Credential references for reposets. Contains no secret values.
